patch_list: AMOLED black

Turns the dark grey of Rumble's raised surfaces (the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags) pure black for OLED screens, optionally near-black so their edges still show. Rumble's dark theme already draws pages, sheets and dialog…
Background audio by default

Makes Settings > Playback > Background Play default to Sound only: leaving the app keeps the sound playing instead of opening a picture-in-picture window. A choice made in Rumble's settings still wins. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settin…
Block ads

Removes video ads (before and during videos and live streams), the ads in feeds and under videos and Home's ad sections, signed in or not. The app never requests them, so it never sends the ad server your advertising ID. Boosted (paid) vid…
Block cookie notice

Stops Rumble's Ketch consent SDK from loading, so the cookie notice never appears and no consent is recorded, and ignores consent recorded earlier. AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and the Facebook SDK's app…
Block update prompts

Stops the "update required" screen and the "new version available" dialog that Rumble turns on remotely, so a patched version keeps working when Rumble raises its minimum version. Update by patching a newer version. On by default. Turn it…
Change app name
Changes the name shown under Rumble's launcher icon and in Android's settings.
Chat keywords

Highlights live chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and use…
Chat timestamps
Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of the sender's name. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.
Clean share links

Removes everything after the ? from Rumble links before they are shared, so tracking tags such as e9s (where you found the video) can't go out with them. Rumble 3.21.0 shares clean links; this keeps them clean if the server starts adding t…
Clone app
Installs Rumble under another package name, so it sits alongside the original app with its own sign-in and settings. Use "Change app name" to tell the two apart in the launcher.
Default playback speed

Starts videos at a chosen playback speed instead of 1x, until you pick another speed in the player. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off (1x). Choose a speed in Lurk settings > Playback.
Default startup tab
Opens Rumble on Home or My Feed every time, instead of the one you last chose. Starts off. Choose a tab in Lurk settings > Interface.
Default video quality

Starts videos at a chosen quality, or the closest one available, instead of Rumble's 480p. Once you pick a quality in the player, Rumble keeps using that one. Starting live streams at it too, and a lower cap on mobile data, are separate se…
Disable analytics

Stops Rumble's own analytics, which it sends whatever the consent setting: clicks, impressions, searches, watch progress and player state, with your user ID, username, advertising ID and AppsFlyer ID, to e.rumble.com and its debug log. Sig…
Disable autoplay

Stops Rumble from playing the next video when one ends, and from playing muted previews in feeds, including the featured video on Home. Only the defaults change: Settings > Playback can turn either back on. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk…
Disable tracking SDKs

Switches Firebase Analytics and Firebase Performance off for good, so recorded consent can't turn them on, and stops the Facebook SDK from initializing itself fully, logging app events or reading the advertising ID by default. Crashlytics…
Don't save searches

Stops Rumble from keeping your searches on the phone and hides the ones it kept, so they no longer show under the search box. Suggestions still come from Rumble's server as you type. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Privacy.
Fill screen
Zooms videos to fill the screen in landscape, cropping the edges instead of showing black bars, on phones taller than 16:9. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.
Hide chat clutter
Hides pinned messages, raid and gift notices and sponsor reads in live chat, each with its own switch, and optionally chat badges or the whole chat. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Chat.
Hide comments and related videos

Hides the comments under videos, and the related videos the video page lists, each with its own switch. Without related videos, Autoplay next video has nothing to play. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Hide Create tab
Removes the Create (camera and upload) button from the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Hide Home sections

Hides Home's categories, creators and playlists rows, each with its own switch, and any section whose title you list in Lurk settings, such as Live or Rumble Originals. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Hide Join and Shop buttons
Hides the Join (paid channel membership) and Shop (a creator's store) buttons next to Follow on channels and videos, each with its own switch. Starts off. Turn them on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Hide Premium upsells

Hides Rumble Premium promotions: the sheet that opens over videos, the Upgrade Now banner on Home and My Feed, the special offer on the account screen, the downloads pitch and Premium gifts in live chat. Premium-only videos still say so.
Hide premium-only videos

Leaves videos only Rumble Premium members can watch out of Home, related videos, search and categories, unless your account has access to them. Other lists, such as channel pages and My Feed, may still show them. Starts off. Turn it on in…
Hide Shorts
Removes Shorts from the bottom bar, Home, My Feed, channel pages, categories and search. Shorts links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Hide tipping and Rants

Hides the Tip buttons on channels, videos and Shorts, Rants (paid live chat messages) and paying with Rumble Wallet. Rants other viewers send still show. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Keep playing during other sounds

Choose whether Rumble pauses when another app plays sound: always (Rumble's behavior), only for longer interruptions, or never. Calls still pause playback. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.
Keep screen on while paused

Keeps the screen on while a video is paused in the player, as it is during playback. When the video ends or you leave the player, the screen can turn off again. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.
Lurk icon
Replaces Rumble's launcher icon with the Lurk icon, including the themed icon on Android 13+.
Player gestures

In landscape, swipe up or down on the left of the video to change the brightness, on the right to change the volume. Rumble's own double-tap to skip stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.
Refresh stream
When a video or live stream fails, tap the error screen to reload it at the same point. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.
Remember playback speed

Keeps the playback speed you last picked for every video, including after Rumble restarts, instead of going back to 1x. Live streams without rewind still play at 1x. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.
Remove tracking permissions

Removes the advertising ID, ad measurement, install referrer and phone state permissions. On Android 13 and newer, every SDK and Rumble's own requests then get an all-zero advertising ID; on Android 12 and older, Google Play services hands…
Resume videos when signed out

Starts videos where you left off when you aren't signed in, from the positions Rumble already keeps on the phone. Signed in, Rumble's own watch progress is unchanged. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Playback.
Seek interval
Sets how far the player's rewind and forward buttons skip, instead of 15 seconds. Starts off. Choose it in Lurk settings > Playback.
Show deleted messages

Shows the text of live chat messages that moderators remove, or that Rumble hides because the sender was muted, after Rumble's "Message was removed by moderator" label. On by default. Turn it off in Lurk settings > Chat.
Show exact counts
Shows view, like, comment, follower and "watching now" counts in full (12,345 instead of 12K). Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.
Sleep timer
Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, including background play and picture-in-picture. Starts off. Choose a time in Lurk settings > Playback.
Unlock Premium

Turns on Rumble's local premium state once you sign in (or sign out and in again): the app then treats you as a Premium member, which skips its ad requests and Premium upsells. Rumble's server still decides premium-only videos, live gates,…
